fact: A December 2018 feasibility study found that use of remote sensing and derived information remains marginal in the Senegalese institutions met, apart from specialist producers such as the CSE, while CNAAS was testing satellite rainfall and evapotranspiration indices for index insurance.
title: Projet GEOforAGRI: Etude de faisabilité pour un projet de renforcement de l'utilisation de l'imagerie satellitaire en appui aux politiques publiques agricoles et de gestion durable des ressources, en Afrique de l'Ouest
